entities.summary: David Recordon is an American technologist with an open standards and open source background. He is currently the Chief Technology Officer at Rebellion Defense. From January 2021 to September 2022, he served as the Director of Technology in the White House under U.S. President Joe Biden. He previously served in a similar role during the last two years of the presidency of Barack Obama. Between his roles in government, he worked as Vice President of Infrastructure and Security at the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.
